input.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
method: Bring large pot of salted water to boil
Cook spaghetti according to package directions
While pasta cooks, fry pancetta until crispy
Whisk eggs with grated cheese and black pepper
Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup pasta water
Toss hot pasta with pancetta and fat
Remove from heat and stir in egg mixture quickly
Add pasta water as needed for creamy sauce
input.notes: Must work quickly with eggs to avoid scrambling
